catalysts.name: Reliance, Inc.
catalysts.what: Barclays upgraded Reliance (metals distributor) to Overweight from Equal Weight and raised its price target to $507 from $445 - about 17.8% above the ~$430 price at the time. Shares have since drifted down to $421.07 (-1.5% today) alongside a broad market selloff (S&P 500 -1.9% today), not a reversal of the catalyst itself. Consensus elsewhere is more mixed (Hold rating, ~$415 average target), so this is one bullish desk, not a reconciled consensus upgrade.

catalysts.name: NIQ Global Intelligence Plc
catalysts.what: NIQ beat Q3 2026 estimates (adjusted EPS $0.30 vs $0.23 consensus; revenue $1.12B, +6.3% y/y, vs ~$1.11B expected) and raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $1.16-$1.20 from $1.08-$1.12, its first GAAP-profitable quarter since its July 2025 IPO. Shares rose modestly in the premarket on the print; some commentary flags that the stock had already run up sharply (+54% since August) into the report, a risk to watch. No confirmed day-of closing reaction found (no OHLC tape available to this routine).
